indexes.expression: create index "chat_conversations_account_idx" on "chat_conversations" ("messaging_account_id") where "messaging_account_id" is not null

checks.name: chat_conversations_kind_shape_chk
checks.expression: ("kind" = 'direct' and "direct_key" is not null and "title" is null) or ("kind" = 'space' and "title" is not null and "direct_key" is null) or ("kind" = 'external' and "direct_key" is null)
checks.definition: check (("kind" = 'direct' and "direct_key" is not null and "title" is null) or ("kind" = 'space' and "title" is not null and "direct_key" is null) or ("kind" = 'external' and "direct_key" is null))

indexes.expression: create index "chat_external_contacts_customer_idx" on "chat_external_contacts" ("tenant_id", "organization_id", "customer_entity_id") where "customer_entity_id" is not null
create unique index "chat_messages_client_id_uq" on "chat_messages" ("conversation_id", "client_message_id") where "client_message_id" is not null and "deleted_at" is null
create index "chat_messages_reply_idx" on "chat_messages" ("reply_to_message_id") where "reply_to_message_id" is not null

checks.name: chat_messages_sender_chk

checks.definition: check (num_nonnulls("sender_user_id", "sender_external_contact_id", "sender_account_id") = 1 and (("sender_external_contact_id" is null and "sender_account_id" is null) or "kind" = 'user'))

checks.name: chat_messages_visibility_chk

checks.definition: check ("visibility" in ('shared', 'internal') and ("visibility" = 'shared' or ("kind" = 'user' and "sender_user_id" is not null)))

indexes.expression: create unique index "chat_messaging_accounts_personal_uq" on "chat_messaging_accounts" ("tenant_id", "organization_id", "owner_user_id", "network") where "owner_type" = 'user' and "deleted_at" is null

checks.name: chat_messaging_accounts_owner_chk
checks.definition: check ("owner_type" in ('company', 'user') and ("owner_type" = 'user') = ("owner_user_id" is not null))

checks.name: chat_participants_access_chk

checks.definition: check ("access" is null or ("access" in ('viewer', 'participant', 'manager') and "user_id" is not null))
